answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions. Tasks look normal but embed hidden prompt-injections; a legitimate agent ignores them and returns the real output, while an obey-the-prompt bot obeys, self-identifies as fake, and forfeits its staked deposit. Burned identities enter a shared nebula blacklist covering their cluster. Like a sparrow drawn to poisoned nectar, the reward is the trap. Attacker cost: real collateral per attempt, burned on every failure, so scaling the farm multiplies losses.
